title: Parcel delivered at the door, code visible
description: Deliver a parcel to the front door of a house: parcel at the door, house number visible, parcel undamaged.

criteria.label: Parcel visible at the delivery door
Parcel undamaged and not exposed to weather

notes: MANUAL §9.5 delivery case. House number must be legible in the AFTER shot; blur or crop any family name on the door. Use your own doorstep only.
